description: Project scaffolding — directory structure, settings, pyproject.toml, content migration from jericho01, 9 council member profiles
API client — unified OpenRouter + Mancer client with retry, rate limiting, structured response parsing
Council member registry — load/list/validate YAML profiles, get member by name, list all members
Memory system — per-agent read/write, core beliefs, session log (JSONL), shared council memory
Proposal system — create, list, review proposals with structured markdown format and lifecycle tracking
Voting engine — cast votes, tally, quorum check, approval threshold, human veto power
Council session orchestrator — full session lifecycle: context load, briefing, activity phase, record, summary
Agent-to-agent chat — orchestrator-mediated conversations between council members with memory recording
Human-to-agent chat — direct conversation with individual council members, memories updated
Discussion rounds — structured multi-agent discussion on a proposal before voting
Character template system — structured YAML format for AI character definitions with traits, backstory, prompt
Collaborative character design — council members contribute to character creation via structured prompts
Character evolution — propose and vote on modifications to existing characters via governance system
CLI interface — Click-based 'jericho' command with subcommands for council, chat, vote, characters, status
Rich terminal dashboard — council status display, vote tallies, session activity, member overview
Session analytics — track participation rates, voting patterns, proposal success rates, member activity
Test suite — comprehensive tests for API client, council registry, memory, governance, and orchestrator
Memory influence — memories affect agent responses via context injection with relevance scoring
Council expansion — agents can propose adding new council members via governance system
Prompt evolution history — visual timeline of how prompts and characters changed over council decisions
